import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished 3D PUBG-style battle royale web game with a Fortnite-like building mechanic, playable on desktop and mobile.

## Requirements
- User request: "3D battle royale PUBG-style with building"
- Must work in the existing empty PlayGround repo, using Vite/Three.js.
- Support Android/iOS responsive layouts and touch controls.
- Verify in a real browser with screenshots; use tmux for long-lived servers.

## Decisions
- Original game titled **LAST CIRCLE**, set on stylized island **ISLA VERDE**.
- Three.js + Vite; procedural world, no external art assets; local WOFF2 fonts for offline reliability.
- 24-player solo match: player + 23 AI bots, shrinking zone, loot, armor/medkits, 4 weapons.
- Building mechanic: walls/floors/ramps, 150 wood, 10 wood per piece, snapped placement, ghost preview.
- Drop intro with plane/parachute, third-person camera, minimap/full map, kill feed, mobile joystick and buttons.
- Desktop controls: WASD, Shift sprint, Space jump, LMB fire, RMB aim, R reload, F heal, B build, 1–3 build/weapon slots, M map, Esc pause.
- Menus: cinematic start screen with primary CTA text `PLAY` for automatic capture start, pause, win/death results.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `package.json`, `index.html`, full `src/style.css` UI/menu/HUD/mobile design.
- Downloaded local fonts into `public/fonts/`.
- Implemented game modules:
  - `src/data.js`: island constants, sites, roads, loot metadata.
  - `src/weapons.js`: 4 weapons, weapon models, muzzle flash, pickup models.
  - `src/audio.js`: WebAudio synth SFX and ambience.
  - `src/world.js`: terrain, lighting/sky, water, clouds, plane, vegetation, loot, collision/raycast, map conversion, world update.
  - `src/structures.js`: all compounds, buildings, props, towers, containers, loot spots.
  - `src/loot.js`: site/wild loot population.
  - `src/map.js`: pre-rendered tactical map canvas.
  - `src/building.js`: ghost previews and built wall/floor/ramp pieces.
  - `src/player.js`: movement, drop/parachute, camera, shooting, reload, healing, pickups, building, damage.
  - `src/bots.js`: 23 bot AI, target selection, movement, shooting, damage, death.
  - `src/effects.js`: tracers and particle effects.
  - `src/zone.js`: shrinking-zone phases, blue wall shader, damage.
  - `src/ui.js`: HUD, compass, minimap/full map, kill feed, toasts, pause/result, build bar, mobile UI state.

### Active
- `src/main.js` has NOT been created yet. This is the critical missing integration file.
- Need to install dependencies, run Vite, test gameplay/screenshots, and fix runtime bugs.

### Blocked
- None technically, but no runnable app until `src/main.js` exists.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/main.js` integrating renderer/camera/scene, `World`, `Player`, `BotManager`, `Zone`, `Effects`, `AudioEngine`, `UI`.
2. Implement input: pointer lock mouse look/fire, keyboard, touch joystick/look drag/buttons, build placement, map/pause/result flow.
3. Implement `Game` methods expected by modules: `hitscan`, `onLanded`, `onBotKilled`, `onPlayerDeath`, `endMatch`, `deploy`, `regenerateMap`.
4. Run `npm install`, `npm run build`, start via tmux on port 3002, capture desktop/mobile screenshots, inspect and fix JS/WebGL errors.
5. Tune performance/shadows and gameplay balance if screenshots or FPS reveal issues.
6. Update `README.md` and commit/push if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: DOM IDs/UI structure required by `ui.js` and `main.js`.
- `src/ui.js`: exact HUD IDs and methods main must call.
- `src/player.js`: input shape, camera, shooting, `hitscan` expectations, build/health APIs.
- `src/bots.js`: bot manager update and `game.hitscan`/`game.onBotKilled` contracts.
- `src/zone.js`: zone lifecycle and UI/audio hooks.
- `src/world.js`: world construction, physics helpers, `placeLoot`, map canvas.
- `src/structures.js`: contains a slightly hacky `doorSideGeometry` using global `currentWorld`; verify no generation failure.
- `src/building.js`: player-built piece APIs.
- `src/weapons.js`: `WEAPONS`, `getFlashTexture`, pickup/weapon model builders.
- `src/effects.js`: tracer/particle API.
- `src/audio.js`: `AudioEngine` methods.
- `src/map.js` / `src/data.js`: map generation and constants.
- `src/style.css`: `.hidden`, `.touch`, `.building`, overlay IDs and responsive rules.
- `package.json`: deps `three ^0.187.0`, `vite ^8.3.5`.

## Important Context
- Repo was essentially empty; current files are uncommitted/untracked.
- Runtime serves static `dist` or plain `index.html`; Vite build uses `--base ./`.
- Default screenshot capture auto-clicks only buttons labeled exactly `Start`/`Play`; CTA is `PLAY`.
- Mobile screenshot is viewport-only, so UI adds `.touch` when `pointer: coarse` OR `innerWidth < 760`.
- Potential bugs to verify:
  - `Player.checkPickups` decrements `_pickupTimer` by fixed `1/60`, not dt.
  - `structures.js` `doorSideGeometry` relies on a global `currentWorld` and local `worldRef`; works only when called from `makeBuilding`.
  - `Zone.applyDamage` calls `player.damage` every second with armor ignored; may cause repeated red flashes.
  - `UI` references `this.buildValid` element that does not exist (`#build-valid`), but only stores null, not used.
  - `world.js` uses `UP_VEC`, now defined.
  - `Bot` flash timeout only set when firing; verify animation.
  - `main.js` must set `game.elapsed`, `game.state`, `game.camera`, `game.player`, `game.world`, `game.botManager`, `game.zone`, `game.effects`, `game.audio`, `game.ui`.
- Gameplay contract details:
  - `game.hitscan(origin, dir, range, shooter)` should return nearest hit containing `{point, distance, bot?, player?, head?, kind?}`.
  - `game.onBotKilled(bot, attacker, def, head)` should update kills/killfeed/alive count/win, possibly drop loot.
  - `game.onPlayerDeath(attacker)` should set placement based on alive count and show result after brief delay.
  - `onLanded()` should set `state='playing'`, start zone, bots, and HUD messaging.
- Start player weapons: `RANGER AR` with 30 mag/90 reserve; 2 medkits; 0 armor; 150 wood.
- Zone starts on landing; initial radius 235; 6 phases ending in final circle.
- Build placement snaps yaw to 90° and x/z to 2m grid; cost 10; max materials 150.
- CSS `#build-valid` is absent; remove or ignore.
- Suggested tmux command for server: `PORT=3002 npm run server` after adding a server script, or use `node .../default-start.mjs`; current `start.sh` relies on `RUNTIME_DIR`.
- Capture can be done with `CAPTURE_URL=http://localhost:3002 CAPTURE_DIR=screenshots npm run ...` via runtime script or Playwright.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished 3D PUBG-style battle royale web game with a Fortnite-like building mechanic, playable on desktop and mobile.

## Requirements
- User request: "3D battle royale PUBG-style with building".
- Must work in the existing PlayGround repo, using Vite/Three.js.
- Support Android/iOS responsive layouts and touch controls.
- Verify in a real browser with screenshots; use tmux for long-lived servers.

## Decisions
- Original game titled **LAST CIRCLE**, set on stylized island **ISLA VERDE**.
- Three.js + Vite; procedural world, no external art assets; local WOFF2 fonts for offline reliability.
- 24-player solo match: player + 23 AI bots, shrinking zone, loot, armor/medkits, 4 weapons.
- Building mechanic: walls/floors/ramps, 150 wood, 10 wood per piece, snapped placement, ghost preview.
- Drop intro with plane/parachute, third-person camera, minimap/full map, kill feed, mobile joystick and buttons.
- Desktop controls: WASD, Shift sprint, Space jump, LMB fire, RMB aim, R reload, F heal, B build, 1–3 build/weapon slots, M map, Esc pause.
- Menus: cinematic start screen with primary CTA text `PLAY` for automatic capture start, pause, win/death results.
- Match reset reuses the generated world, trims built pieces/colliders/surfaces/loot, and recreates bots rather than rebuilding terrain.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created full project: `package.json`, `index.html`, `src/style.css`, local fonts in `public/fonts/`.
- Implemented all game modules: `data.js`, `weapons.js`, `audio.js`, `world.js`, `structures.js`, `loot.js`, `map.js`, `building.js`, `player.js`, `bots.js`, `effects.js`, `zone.js`, `ui.js`.
- Created `src/main.js`: renderer/scene/camera, `Game` lifecycle, boot/menu/drop/play/pause/map/result flow, desktop/mouse/keyboard input, touch joystick/look/buttons, hitscan, bot/player death, win/loss, reset/redeploy.
- `npm install` completed; `npm run build` succeeds (Vite, 676.79 kB JS bundle, font path warnings only).
- Dev server running in tmux session `lastcircle` on port 3002; build succeeded.
- Desktop browser verification completed for menu, parachute drop, landing/gameplay, combat/kill feed, building ghost + placed wall, full map, pause, and death/result screens.
- Fixed runtime crash: `Player.buildWeaponModels` ran before `weaponMount` existed; reordered to `buildBody()` then `buildWeaponModels()`.
- Fixed `Sprite.rotation` read-only crash in `bots.js` and `player.js`; now set `flash.material.rotation`.
- Fixed bot count: added `BOT_COUNT = 23` in `bots.js` so HUD correctly shows 24 total.
- Tuned bot combat: reduced player/bot detection ranges, longer aim/fire delays, lower bot-vs-player and bot-vs-bot damage.
- Added `Effects.reset()`, `Zone.reset()`, `UI.zoneUpdate()`, map open/close hooks, alive-count death awareness, and `checkPickups(game, dt)`.
- Fixed mobile touch button layout: four small buttons were missing `tbtn-build`/`tbtn-heal`/`tbtn-swap`/`tbtn-reload` classes in `index.html`; classes added.
- Adjusted mobile HUD spacing: drop readout moved to 28% top; vitals/weapon panels moved to 186px bottom; build bar to 190px bottom.

### Active
- Re-verify mobile HUD/touch layout after the latest `index.html` + `src/style.css` edits; server is Vite dev with HMR, so reload the `lcm` Playwright session.
- Perform final desktop/mobile captures and check for console errors.
- Possibly investigate remaining minor visual issue: camera can clip through freshly built walls when rotating quickly (pale overlay seen in one combat capture; likely built-wall/camera smoothing, not yet confirmed).

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Reload mobile session `lcm`, start match, screenshot portrait HUD and touch controls; confirm no overlaps/cutoffs.
2. Test mobile joystick, look-drag, fire, jump, heal, reload, swap, build placement, and mobile map/pause.
3. Re-check desktop after HMR for console errors and capture final desktop/mobile screenshots.
4. Optionally verify zone shrink, bot elimination/win flow, and redeploy reset.
5. Update `README.md` with game description/controls, then commit/push if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: game loop, input, match lifecycle, hitscan, results, reset logic.
- `src/player.js`: movement, drop/parachute, camera, shooting, building, pickups, damage.
- `src/bots.js`: 23-bot AI, spawn logic, combat tuning.
- `src/zone.js`: shrinking-zone phases, damage, `reset()`.
- `src/world.js`: terrain, structures, loot, collision, raycast, map canvas.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, minimap/full map, kill feed, pause/result, map hooks.
- `src/building.js`: ghost previews, built wall/floor/ramp pieces, colliders.
- `src/style.css`: responsive HUD, touch controls, menus, mobile spacing at `max-width: 640px`.
- `index.html`: HUD/menu/map DOM; touch button classes now corrected.
- `screenshots/`: verification captures (`menu.png`, `drop.png`, `play3.png`, `build-*.png`, `map.png`, `pause.png`, `mobile-menu.png`, `mobile-drop.png`, debug files).
- `package.json`: `three ^0.187.0`, `vite ^8.3.5`; scripts `dev`, `build`, `preview`.

## Important Context
- Repo was initially empty; all files are uncommitted/untracked.
- Dev server: `npm run dev -- --port 3002 --strictPort` in tmux session `lastcircle`.
- Playwright sessions: `lc` desktop at 1050x793; `lcm` mobile emulation at 360x732 (`(pointer: coarse)` true).
- `playwright-cli` browser was installed via `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; use `DISPLAY=:0`.
- Capture runtime: `CAPTURE_URL=http://localhost:3002 CAPTURE_DIR=screenshots npm run ...` runs `default-capture.mjs`, waits 1s after auto-clicking `PLAY`.
- Vite font warnings are benign: `../fonts/...woff2 referenced ... didn't resolve at build time`; `public/fonts` copies to `dist/fonts`.
- `THREE.Clock` and `PCFSoftShadowMap` deprecation warnings are benign.
- `Player` start loadout: `RANGER AR` 30/90, 2 medkits, 0 armor, 150 wood.
- `onLanded()` spawns bots around player, starts zone, sets state `playing`.
- Bots currently spawn after landing; HUD shows alive `1` during drop, 24 after landing.
- Death result was verified: placement `#17`, 1 kill, 72 damage, 0:18 survived, killed by `WRAITH`, with REDEPLOY/MAIN MENU buttons.
- Mobile screenshot before fixes showed `ALIVE 1` during drop, minimap overlapping drop readout, and small touch buttons collapsed to intrinsic size; latest patches target these.
